2.50.11
Matrix.Left
Applies to RDL 2003/10 and RDL 2005/01
The Matrix.Left element specifies the distance of a matrix from the left of the matrix's container. This
element is optional. If this element is present, its value MUST be a non-negative RDLSize constant. If
the Matrix.Left element is not present, its value is interpreted as "0".
Following is the parent element of the Matrix.Left element.
Parent elements
Matrix
The following is the XML Schema definition of the Matrix.Left element.
 <xsd:element name="Left" type="SizeType" minOccurs="0" />
